{{Quote|Me always knows good opportunity when me sees it.|translated=1|The Rodian prisoner|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
This '''Rodian''' was among a crew of [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that were held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] aboard the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']], [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] in [[3956 BBY]].

==Biography==
Working as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], this Rodian served aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that plied the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Detained by the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|''Leviathan'']], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]], within [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith space]] in [[3956 BBY]], this Rodian was being held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], awaiting interrogation. Earlier interrogations had already broken the minds of the [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]] and [[Astrogation/Legends|navigator]], rendering them incoherent with pain and rage. Hoping to avoid a similar fate, this Rodian was able to assist Revan and his companions in [[Skirmish aboard the Leviathan|escaping]] [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. In exchange for being released from his holding cell, the Rodian smuggler agreed to provide an [[ICE breaker]], a piece of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] equipment that would enable the user to bypass safety systems.

==Behind the scenes==
Which companion sets the Rodian prisoner free depends upon player choices within the context of the game.
